title: Add custom serialize_string function producing shorter representation
author: mina86
summary: Adds a crate-local serialize::string that picks single or double quotes to minimise escapes, and drops the space after a hex escape when the next char isn't a hex digit. Most of the diff renames call sites to crate::serialize::*. A small size win (strings containing double quotes), recently rebased onto 4a1b083, and the author is frustrated about the wait (2026-11-13). Two problems found that a review must raise.
evidence: (1) Correctness bug: hex_escape omits the terminating space unless the next byte is a hex digit, but CSS Syntax 'consume an escaped code point' also consumes one whitespace after a hex escape. So a control char followed by a real space ("\x01 b") would serialize as `"\1 b"`, and the space would be eaten on re-parse. Fix: also keep the space when the next byte is a space. (2) Cargo.toml adds `cssparser-macros = "*"`, and crates.io rejects wildcard dependency versions at publish. It needs a pinned version (or avoid match_byte). No maintainer comments. Quote-choice changes may alter many existing expected outputs, so check the test diff.
